tokens.title: Parallax background
tokens.mechanism: CSS 3D parallax: a scrolling container with perspective, layers pushed back on the Z axis and scaled back up

relationships: scroll container owns perspective + perspective-origin
layers are direct children and are translated on Z
content layer stays at translateZ(0) to keep text crisp

customProperties.--parallax-depth: translateZ distance of the back layer
customProperties.--parallax-scale: compensating scale for the pushed-back layer

accessibility: Perspective scrolling can trigger motion sickness — gate the depth on prefers-reduced-motion.
Keep scroll-linked motion decorative: no content is revealed only by motion.
fallback: Without 3D transform support the layers stack normally and the page scrolls flat.
iOS Safari ignores perspective on the scrolling root in some versions; test on device.
notes: Prismic entry 1: Depth-layered nature scene where background layers scroll slower than the foreground.

tokens.title: Sticky full page slides
tokens.mechanism: CSS scroll snap: a snap container plus snap targets, with snapped state queried from CSS

relationships: scroll container carries scroll-snap-type
snap target carries scroll-snap-align AND container-type: scroll-state
a child of the snap target reads the snapped state

accessibility: Snap containers must stay keyboard scrollable; do not trap focus on the snapped item.
mandatory snapping can strand users on long items — prefer proximity when items exceed the viewport.
fallback: Without scroll-state support the items keep their resting styles and snapping still works.
Snapped queries fire like scrollsnapchanging (earliest hook); use the scrollsnapchange JS event when you need the settled state.

tokens.title: Text scroll on reveal effects

relationships: animated element is inside (or names) the scroll container that provides the timeline
